```artifact
## Use-Cases & User Stories

**User Story 1:** As a Hospital Staff member, I want to identify the information acquired from Patients, Chemists, and Labs so that I can understand the data being collected.

**User Story 2:** As a Hospital Staff member, I want to state the requirements of the software so that the development team can understand my needs.

**User Story 3:** As a Hospital Staff member, I want to provide feedback to modify the existing requirements so that the software meets my specific needs.

**User Story 4:** As a Hospital Staff member, I want the document to be the reference document for the Project Management and Development team so that they have clear guidelines for the project.

**User Story 5:** As a Project Management and Development team member, I want to analyze, design, and implement the system so that it meets the requirements of the Hospital Staff.
```
